notes.title: The Small Much Needed Update! (v0.7.1)
notes.notes:
We try our best to keep the game polished and bug free and this patch should fix up a bunch of issues.



Hey look, you can see the curses now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/ae1c1273d1cd1aeaa39162f23946227fca8bd962.gif"]



We got a new Bug Report Form, it's a quick way to make sure a bug is reported without being lost in the sauce.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/7ea2470ac9579c3e7d2ca6942318f5644cfc8ca3.gif"]



Make sure to join the Discord Server, it's the fastest way to keep up with the development.



v0.7.1 Changelogs:

Blood Moon 2 stacks.

'Broken Crystal Ball' makes 3 random low dice predictions.

Angel statue now reveals what curse the weapon has.

Angel curses are seeded.

Report bugs link.

Blood moon polish.

Rare shields are less rare in the weapon chest.

Hover info in daily menu added.

Calculating score accounts for healing.

Fixed some weapons costs in the shop.

'Tenacious Targe' changed to uncommon.

Shopkeeper dialog.

Dice fusion accepts special dice on left side.

Dialog hides on map toggle.

Battle chests dice rarity fixed.

Buffs trigger quicker.

Fixed rotten chance missing D4 rolls.

'Draw' buff renamed to 'Fetch'.

Fixed lagging cursor.



Cheers!

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE - 0.7!
notes.notes:
Today, we're excited to release a new update to the demo!
If you've spent time with the previous version, you're in for a treat, we've added a lot of new content and made several improvements and fixes throughout.




If you’re not familiar with ‘Die for the Lich’ it is a roguelike dice deckbuilder. The mechanic of the game is simple, roll dice and try not to roll over the limit and of course kill as many mythical creatures as possible in the process.

Let’s DIvE into it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/d6ee881dda8606366ea74ddcb9623afde92d31d1.gif"]


New Weapons
You might not have unlocked them all yet, and we’re adding even more.

This time, we focused on weapons that apply buffs and debuffs to mix things up a bit and see how they impact your playstyle.


Dante’s UPDATE
If you haven’t been the biggest fan of Dante, we’ve got some good news, he’s undergone a major rework.

His starting ability has been completely redesigned to create a more distinct experience between the two playable characters.

But if you preferred the old Dante, let us know, we’re actively working with the community to make the best possible changes.


Blood Moon
This is another change that has been welcomed with open arms, the old Blood Moon was a bit too straightforward. The new blood moon brings more strategy to every dice and trinket rolled to keep you on your toes.


New Curses - Djinn
The Angel now offers two new curses: Unlucky Curse and Dice Bound Curse.

Curses also come with a new look, we removed the generic skull with an eye on his forehead design with one inspired by a Djinn, giving them a more fitting and mysterious vibe.


The Blood Blade
Originally intended as a hidden weapon for those willing to seek it out, the Blood Blade gradually lost its secretive charm and became a bit too easy to obtain.

With this update, we’ve reworked its function and price to better reflect its original, more elusive design.

 
Halo + Oracle Ability
Time to start killing more monsters on your way to Ankou because there’s a brand new ability in play, and the old Halo has been reworked.

The Oracle now offers a glimpse into the future with a new per-turn mechanic.

If you’ve been ignoring the Halo because it felt underwhelming, you might want to give it another shot… or keep ignoring it. Either way, it’s definitely more useful now.


Daily Runs UPDATE
If you’ve been battling for the top spot in the Daily Run or even claimed the crown for a day there’s good news for you!

We’ve improved the leaderboard, complete with a button to view yesterday’s scores, and you can now compete directly with your Steam friends.

We hope to see you at the top!

GL Compatibility
If the game is not running smoothly or you’ve not had the chance to play it because your computer is too slow, we may be able to fix that. With our new GL Compatibility option when you first run the game.

This was our way of fixing it, and it seems like it has worked for the few people that have reported having these problems.



We’ve also made a number of smaller changes and fixes, we’ll let you discover those for yourself.


A huge thank you to everyone who’s played, reviewed, and supported the game. It truly means a lot to see how much you're enjoying it, and we’ve loved seeing all the ideas and suggestions you’ve shared.

Here is some fan art from our community.

notes.title: Official Demo Release Date
notes.notes:
It’s been almost five months since we released the web demo, and we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes. Now, we're thrilled to reveal what is new in the Steam demo of Die for the Lich.



Crafting Dice
Take control of your strategy like never before. Our new crafting system lets you forge any die you can imagine, as long as you have the right components. Build the dice that suit your playstyle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/06bfe2e40856c424c2d3493f07de9a5ead868d58.gif"]



New Playable Character
Introducing Dante, an undead poet with a powerful, unique ability that opens up entirely new tactical options. He’s more than just a new face, he’s a whole new way to play.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/916ca3013a6bed6732e5e1dc6dad34182ef44f21.png"]

Strategic Battles We've introduced a new buff/debuff system that makes enemies more dynamic, challenging, and strategically engaging. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/66933f747337be4720834b99ab9ac9123fdbcf90.gif"]



Meta-Progression
This isn’t just a run-based roguelike. Earn powerful dice, trinkets, weapons and abilities over time with our new meta-progression system. Locked behind challenging tasks and achievements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467526/dca9179dfa0427527a3a9580942714c31c4025ca.gif"]


And that’s just a glimpse of what we’ve prepared for the Steam demo.
Don’t leave it to chance and wishlist the game now!

Check out our discord for more updates.
